# Qahera UI Kit

> The AI-Native, Contract-Driven Design System & Multi-Target Component Architecture by Alwkala.

Qahera UI Kit is a deterministic design system engine built for AI pair-programming agents (Google Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf) and human engineers. It enforces 100% source ownership (shadcn-style) with zero runtime dependencies.

- Canonical Registry: 42 Components, 20 Compositional Patterns, 18 Application Templates, 12 Cairo Neighborhood Themes.
- Supported Targets: React 19 (0kb RSC), PHP 8.x Plates, Native HTML/CSS, Web Components, HTMX, Tailwind CSS.
- Zero Emoji (`QAHERA-VISUAL-001`): 41 Registered Semantic SVG Icons.
- Bidirectional Infrastructure: 100% Logical CSS properties (`margin-inline-start`, etc.) with canonical Alexandria & Cairo typography.

## Quick Links

- [NPM Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qahera-ui): `npm i -g qahera-ui` or `npx qahera-ui`
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/alwkala/Qahera-UI-Kit): Source code, contracts, and issue tracker
- [Full Specification](SPEC.md): Normative architecture, 17 invariants, and compiler stages
- [Agent Governance](AGENTS.md): Strict contract rules for AI coding assistants

## Usage with AI Coding Agents

Install and embed the Qahera skill directly into your workspace:

```bash
npx qahera-ui init --target=react
```

This places `.agents/skills/qahera-ui` into your repository. Your AI assistant will automatically use:
- `/qahera-ui compose <screen>`: Generate complete production layouts with canonical components.
- `/qahera-ui pattern <name>`: Scaffold 20 enterprise UX patterns.
- `/qahera-ui theme <neighborhood>`: Switch between the 12 Cairo Atlas themes.
- `/qahera-ui audit`: Verify compliance with the 17 architectural invariants.

## Canonical Components (42)

Accordion, Alert, AspectRatio, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, ButtonGroup, Calendar, Card, Checkbox, CodeBlock, ColorPicker, DataTable, DatePicker, Dialog, Divider, Drawer, Dropdown, EmptyState, FileUpload, Form, Input, Kbd, Menu, Modal, Navbar, Pagination, Popover, ProgressBar, RadioGroup, Select, Skeleton, Slider, Spinner, Switch, Tabs, Textarea, Timeline, Toast, Tooltip, Treeview.

## Compositional Patterns (20)

ConfirmationDialog, DataTableToolbar, FilterBar, SearchToolbar, DashboardStat, ChatStream, EmptyState, FormActions, KanbanBoard, LuxuryProductCard, MetricComparisonGrid, DatePaginator, EditorialStory, FileManagerGrid, Questionnaire, SortableList, StoreLocator, UserCard, VipMembership, PaginationPattern.

## Cairo Atlas Themes (12)

Garden City, Zamalek, Downtown, Heliopolis, Maadi, Roxy, Sakakini, El Hussein, Shubra, El Zaytoun, El Marg, New Cairo.
